channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Mid Atlantic Arts: USArtists International (FY28 round, up to USD 11,000)
item.description: Mid Atlantic Arts, with the National Endowment for the Arts and the Mellon Foundation · deadline 24 Feb 2027 · Grants of up to USD 11,000 toward eligible expenses, with a 1:1 cost match required. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Arts in Community Grants 2027
    https://www.southarts.org/grants-opportunities/arts-community-grants
    South Arts · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Up to USD 10,000 per project, covering artist fees. A dollar-for-dollar cash match is required, so a USD 10,000 request needs USD 10,000 in matching funds. Minimum artist fee is USD 4,000 and the minimum grant request is USD 2,000. No application fee.
  • Guggenheim Fellowship 2027
    https://www.gf.org/program/how-to-apply/
    John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Variable cash grant sized to the applicant's proposed budget and needs; the Foundation does not publish a fixed figure or range, and recent awards have typically run into the tens of thousands of US dollars. Roughly 175 to 200 fellowships are awarded each year across more than 50 fields. The Foundation charges no application fee and has no affiliated application consultants.
